reviews.text: They took great care of our Golden Retriever when she was sick with an upset stomach.

I took, my two month American bully, mixed Pitt bull , by the name of little girl to this place about a week ago. She seemed to have some respiratory issues. But of course because I had some financial issues. I wasn’t able to pay for care.so my question is where is the sympathy beyond. Medical practices. To help an animal in distress. So the final decision given to me about my dog. Was to put her down. And we started to go along with that . Yes we left the dog there because we believed what was being told to us. And we believed we signed paperwork for the baby to put down. Long story short we picked up the baby nursed her back to health along with prayer. And she made a complete recovery. So we’re glad that prayer still works
Angela, thank you for your review!
I enjoyed the veterinary continuing education presented at the Philadelphia Zoo today.  The lecturers were very informative.

Dr. Lillie Davis and the entire team at PASE Oncology are truly wonderful. I don’t live close to South Philly, and initially the distance and the thought of finding parking in the area made me a little hesitant, but parking turned out to be incredibly easy and was never an issue—and I’m so glad I chose them.

My dog deserved the very best care, and I truly believe she received it from Dr. Lillie. She is not only an incredibly knowledgeable oncologist, but also a genuinely empathetic person who clearly loves animals. She took the time to explain complex medical information in a way I could understand and patiently answered all of my questions.

The compassion, kindness, and care Dr. Lillie and her team showed us meant more than I can express. I cannot recommend PASE Oncology highly enough.

Upon referral from backlogged U of P,  we brought our dog, Dudley, here for an oncological exam. We spoke with Dr. Lilly Davis about the outcome of the tests. It was the worst-case result, an inoperable tumor. Dudley is now gone, my wife and I agree we have never met a more compassionate and knowledgeable doctor than Dr. Davis. She assisted and supported us with difficult decisions, we truly felt Dr. Davis was on our side, emotionally and personally.

I had to rush my Ryan, DSH cat, at 2:15 am Sunday morning who seemed to be struggling to breathe.  I walked in and before I could fill out any documents a vet tech asked what was wrong and took Ryan immediately to the Vet.  Another vet tech stood next to me asking me for details on Ryan and what medication if any he was on.  At this point I still hadn't filled out any documents. It was all about Ryan.  I was floored by their response.  I met with his Vet about 2 hours later by then I had filled out the paperwork and had a CPR approved.  Ryan was getting a little better and they asked if he could be given a very little sedative.  I know Ryan he hates the vet, he screamed in Uber Pets all the way to the ER. My vet wraps him in a blanket he is so bad.  So of course I agreed to the sedative.  Ryan is extremely important to us so having discussed options with the vet, I completely agreed to X-rays, blood w

Rushed my dog to this vet she had a seizure . At 3 am …They took her right back . Checked her out all over said she was healthy just to follow up w her regular veterinarian. Super helpful and calm front desk employee was very nice and  helpful.

Pase and specifically Dr Don Astor are incredible. I got a first opinion on having my 5 year old bichon's acl repaired using the tplo technique. The first dog scared me into not doing it. Then my primary Vet, Dr. Courtney Stipp recommended Dr Astor. He does this all the time and was confident this would help my dog. His surgery in May was a success he started walking well only a day later. Dr Astor and his team were so attentive and supportive during the entire process. A few months later his second acl went and we had to do it on the other leg, another success. My dog is walking better than he did before the surgery. While the surgery isn't cheap (cost about 7k per leg) it will definitely improve your dogs quality of life, insurance will pay for this also. If you have a middle aged dog, especially who is energetic don't hesitate to get him the surgery and request Dr. Astor he is outstanding!

We had a great experience with the emergency and surgical team at PASE. In particular, Dr. Samuel provided us with detailed and timely updates on the progress of our dog, which we appreciated greatly. The staff also did a lovely job discussing discharge instructions and return precautions. I did have issues with how some information was communicated to us, but overall, we are grateful for the services they provide to Philadelphia animals and felt our dog was well cared for throughout his stay!

My dog Sophie has been seeing Dr. Guttin in Internal Medicine for the past year, and I can’t say enough good things about our experience. Dr. Guttin is kind, compassionate, and thorough, and it’s clear how much thought and care she puts into managing Sophie’s complicated case. She takes the time to listen, explain things, and carefully consider every detail. I’m so grateful Sophie is in her care, I don’t know what we would do without her. Sophie says thank you, too!
The critical care team here is phenomenal, we're so grateful for their compassionate care of our sweet Charlie girl when she was very sick. Highly recommend PASE! ❤️

saved the life of one of my Cats, thank you so very much. only thing: i wish they woulda told me when they triaged him that that would be the last moment i could see him before treatment, bc i was beside myself thinking he didnt get to hear me love on him before he went to treatment. that being said, i am more concerned with their medical expertise and care for my Babies than i am concerned about being a blubbering mess. they prolly realized he was acute, and made the best choice for him, and im totally cool with them taking swift action to save his life. i also appreciated their followups, as well as their offer to move him for sooner surgery if i so wanted (we decided against it, and they performed his surgery). this was especially a critical surgery, as he has had TumTum surgery before!!! please pray for my Guy and his Sister!!!!!!! GOD BLESS!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Had to say goodbye to Mud today. Even though she almost made it to 18, it was still an absolutely gut-wrenching experience. When Mud was rushed into the hospital 2 days ago, the staff at PASE was unbelievable. Then from updates, to visits, the care itself, up to and after saying goodbye…the entire staff was amazing, compassionate and kind. Calling them staff feels impersonal and rude.

Here are the people who helped Mud:

Dr. Lenker
Dr. Zager
Dr. Matula
Dr. Hillstead

Nurses:
Kelina
Tatiyana
Gillian
Briana

Front desk:
Alexandria
Gianna
Madelyn

Thank you so much for what you do. You’re all amazing people.

I cannot say enough nice things here to adequately capture how grateful I am to PASE (Dr. Matula, Erin, Bri, and the entire team) for the incredible care they provided to our puppy baby, Teddy. They saved Teddy’s life during an emergent and unexpected critical illness, and they also diagnosed her during this period with a chronic and challenging to identify underlying condition. Thanks to PASE, Teddy survived and is doing well at home, and we now know how to keep her safe from future harm. The team was overall wonderful to work with every step of the way—thorough, kind, and loving to our puppy when we couldn’t be with her in the hospital. I trusted them and greatly valued the care they took to communicate with us in a timely and transparent manner. Although no one wishes their pets to be sick or need urgent/emergent medical care, we look forward to continuing to seek care with the PASE team in the future if needed.
The staff at PASE are incredible. A little coffee bar in the waiting room. Keep in mind that emergency room wait times can vary. Everyone was so helpful and nice.

Overall my experience was positive, it was a busy Saturday but I still feel like Dr. Nina was giving me and my pet her full attention. That being said, I waited a long time just to authorize bloodwork to find a cause of his symptoms, and went home with medicine to administer myself. My pet wasn’t getting anything to help him feel better the entire time we were there. The medicine prescribed here was different than what another vet had prescribed 2 weeks prior, and these new prescriptions made a noticeable difference in my pet’s behavior, he certainly seemed to feel better, so I’m thankful for that.

PASE was a great help in my time of need. My dog Lucy was hurt it was Friday night and I needed to get medical treatment. I googled animal hospitals and found PASE which was relatively close by. We were in & out within an hour with medication and instructions for Lucy. The vet was caring and compassionate, she answered all my questions and called the following day to check on Lucy. I would recommend PASE to anyone looking for emergency care.

I am incredibly disappointed with the dismissive care and complete lack of empathy my cat and I received at this emergency hospital. I brought him in at 1:00 AM because he was lethargic, running a fever, and experiencing a respiratory issue (sneezing, mouth breathing). Because I rescued him off the street about a month and a half ago, I emphasized to both the tech and the veterinarian that he had been under extreme stress—first from being abandoned outside, and then from transitioning into a household with my other cats.
Instead of listening to this critical medical history, the veterinarian was condescending and showed little to no care. Because I had limited funds and could not immediately authorize hundreds of dollars in advanced diagnostics, she essentially washed her hands of us, stating she wasn't sure what else she could do for me and telling me I was "better off" spending my money at a regular vet. I had to explicitly ask for basic supportive care—fluids and an antibiotic injection to help lower his fever—which she agreed to, but after leaving $455 poorer, my cat was no better than when we arrived.
The very next day, I took him to our regular veterinarian. Within just 10 minutes of a standard physical exam, they correctly diagnosed him with a Feline Herpes Virus (FHV-1) flare-up triggered entirely by—you guessed it—extreme stress. They were so appalled by the treatment I received at this ER that they even waived our exam fee.
Did the ER doctor even listen to a word I said, or bother to perform a basic physical exam? Did she ever think to rule out the most common, stress-induced causes before pushing expensive diagnostics and making a worried pet owner feel inferior?
This clinic cared more about my financial constraints than the living, breathing animal in front of them. Next time, I will gladly drive much farther to a different emergency hospital to ensure my pets are treated with dignity and competent medical care. Save your money and your sanity—avoid this place.

During such a stressful event everyone at this facility was so kind, understanding, and knowledgeable. Genuinely, from the front desk to the vet I felt so safe with my baby here. Thank you for letting me cry and listening through sobs and thank you for taking care of my baby. After 3 vets/urgent cares this experience was such a big change.

The oncology team at PASE has been incredible. We took our almost 4 year old cat Susu in when she was sick, and after opting for an ultrasound and additional tests discovered she had lymphoma. It was devastating news, but Dr Davis and her team were incredibly kind, compassionate, and explained our options and potential outcomes.

At every weekly oncology appointment, along with the usual updates on her health we were told how wonderful Susu is, and how sweet, and they were always happy to see pictures and hear funny stories about her. Everyone clearly cared about her just as much as we do, and we were 100% certain she was in the best hands. Any questions we asked were answered, and we knew we could contact PASE at any time if we had concerns or additional questions. They also always asked about our other cat, Morpheus (who we had to bring in around the same time as treatment started for stress-related reasons).

After the full course of treatment, we got the wonderful news that she's in full remission! It's been amazing seeing her improve week by week, and ringing the bell with the team when she graduated from treatment felt incredible. Again, thank you so much to Dr Davis and the oncology team- and especially Laura, who was usually the person to take Susu to and from the waiting room and always shared whatever silly antics Susu got up to while being treated. Y'all made a very scary time much more manageable.
Really disappointing on every level. Find somewhere more deserving for your pet.

Totally I’m just a awe

I’ve been visiting this vet for a couple weeks now, due to an individual running over her with a e bike on the sidewalk.

At first they seemed like a professional vet was in a hurry when the accident occurred so another vet recommended me to them.
Honestly this was the worst decision ever first they Judge you not by man or woman but by the color of your skin. While they allow Caucasians to come and leave with no issues it does not mean the same for the next person.
One visit I asked them can I pay for the bill while they fix / change bandages for my animal. They said “no”
The next visit the first thing I was asked is “how are you paying for this visit and what’s the limit on my account”
Second visit I used my parents acct it was no issue
Went back “this the last time you can use your parents acct”
All of the front desk representatives need to be retrained on customer service besides one girl she was soooo helpful perfect customer service no issues.
I travel far to get to this location every week.
“You can’t leave the front of the building area”
I go this visit and some lady walks in with a stroller and says I’m coming to pick up my dog.

ZERO ISSUES THEY GAVE THE LADY PERFECT SERVICE.

I proceeded to go out to grab something quick to eat I come back to the visit. “We need you to stay in the front you can’t leave the vet”
The double standard here is outrageous poor customer service and they do take it out on your pets so be careful.

Make sure you know what you signing when they do them X-rays. They asked what should be done with her when she got hit by the bike I said I want to know everything what’s wrong with her.
They presented me with just a “leg X-ray” she got hit be a e-bike and all they did was a “leg X-ray”

I took my dog and left not returning back to this racist prejudice place advise everyone just go find another location
Really wanted to leave them a great review when all this was over just totally shocked

I brought my cat who unfortunately fell into congestive heart failure. I felt confident in his care of three overnight stays, mainly facilitated by Dr. Matula and Erin McCallion. With their constant messages and updates, I knew that my cat would be made comfortable and happy until he could get more specialized care elsewhere. PASE was also so wonderful with letting me see my cat at a moment’s notice! I would strongly refer any person or family dealing with a pet medical emergency to PASE. Without a doubt. Thank you for all you do, PASE.

We had an emergency cat neurology situation on Friday and needed a consult and possible MRI ASAP. We are in Chester County and had not heard of PASE; I was hesitant to go into the city, but they were able to get us scheduled immediately for Saturday morning. They not only have a neurologist on duty on Saturdays, they also perform MRIs on Saturdays which, apparently, is not common for most specialty vet practices to perform MRIs over the weekend.

Madeline was professional, friendly and compassionate taking my call and handling my appointment. She was on duty when we arrived and could not have been more helpful or kind. I did not catch the other young woman's name at the front desk, but she and Madeline are A+ assets as public representatives of the facility and caring individuals.

Alexis, our neurology tech, was friendly, through and explained the consult process so that we felt comfortable. Dr. Kerns, could not have been better. He explained everything about his examination and interpretation of our cat's records and history. He answered my many, many questions and gave us a detailed explanation of the situation and recommended follow-up treatment. He never made us feel pressured into additional services and was understanding when we decided to wait to pursue the MRI closer to home (our situation was determined not to be life threatening).

My only disappointment is that they are not closer to our home as I would definitely choose them for our follow-up care if they were. I would not hesitate to recommend PASE to anyone and am grateful that they were there when we needed them.

I would like to thank Dr Astor and his professional staff for the care they given my dog Chase.  My dog was diagnosed with a soft tissue sarcoma tumor that ulcerated under his arm and chest area, Dr  Astor explained all steps very thorough and came up with a plan for my dog.  I was nervous to put him under the surgery as he’s 14 but he did great! He was in the best hands and he treated my dog with his expertise, love and compassionate in what he does best.  My dog had the tumor removed with success, I’m forever grateful for him and his staff , they are beyond caring and loving and treat your animal like it’s their own.  Top notch care for my sweet boy Chase !  Dr Astor is hands down the best sturgeon and I’m forever grateful and thankful for saving my dogs life!

These guys are good. Brought our cat in with the soft tissue sarcoma and we went with the amputation option. Dr. Samuel and Dr. Davis gave us all the information we needed to make the informed decision and were very responsive and personable with questions and concerns. They took incredible care of our cat while they had her, and she came out the other end of the experience no worse for wear; just two weeks later she's zooming up and down stairs.

I am beyond impressed with the care and customer service at PASE! From the moment I called, I knew my fur baby was in good hands. The young lady who answered the phone was incredibly kind, patient, and compassionate. I had a million and one questions because I was so worried about my fur baby, Zoey, and she answered every single one with empathy, understanding, and reassurance. She truly helped put my mind at ease before we even arrived.

Once we got there, the entire staff was just as amazing. Everyone was welcoming, caring, professional, and treated Zoey with so much love. The veterinarian took the time to explain everything clearly, and I never felt rushed. I also appreciated that their pricing was fair and that they offer payment plan options, which can be such a relief during an unexpected emergency.

The best part? Just as the doctor said, within about 30 minutes of treatment, Zoey was already starting to feel better. Seeing our happy, playful, tail-wagging baby return meant everything to our family.

Thank you to everyone at PASE for taking such wonderful care of our precious Zoey. Your kindness, compassion, professionalism, and exceptional care will never be forgotten. We are beyond grateful. Y’ALL ROCK! 🫶🏾🐾❤️
The emergency care our dog (Mylo) received was fantastic.  The Doctor and staff will be forever in our prayers.

I had to take my dog Randall here because he ingested some foreign objects he was not supposed to. I found the staff to be very friendly and responsive. They also did not push me to get any unnecessary tests or procedures that run up costs, Which I greatly appreciate. As of now, Randall is doing great!

They ran mri and bloodwork. Then admitted my cat, Lola overnight for observation.

The doctor I worked with was pretty direct about poor condition of my cat. I was hopeful, but also knew she was touch/go.

Unfortunately got the call at 3:30 am for cardiac arrest.

I was glad with the care I received and they were there for my baby, especially at end of life. The compassion and quality was super important to me as I wasn’t able to make it for the end.

Thank you!
Too long and too expensive but still the best there is in an emergency!

This place is amazing, from the front desk, to the techs, to the drs. EVERYONE was so kind, knowledgeable, & sympathetic to our situation. We brought in our precious Turi & were immediately greeted with kindness, compassion, & humans who knew exactly what we were going through. We will forever be grateful for the exceptional care shown to our girl throughout this process, the extra time at home that allowed us to show her so much love, & the updates/communication/making us actually feel heard! Losing a pet is never an ideal situation & the staff at PASE made this experience bearable.  Thank you♡♡♡
Overall, an excellent experience! Helped save our little Kitty and the front desk staff is super friendly and helpful!

I cannot say enough about the team at PASE. Our five year old dog Dexter came down suddenly with a rare neurological condition (MUO) that cost him the use of his hind legs, and what followed was the scariest few weeks of our lives. From start to finish, this hospital carried us through it.

Dr. Kerns and Stephanie and the entire neurology team have been extraordinary, patient, and thorough in diagnosing and treating Dexter and in explaining every step to us along the way. When Dexter had a life threatening reaction and went into crisis in the middle of the night, the overnight ER doctor and nurses (whose names we sadly never got) quite literally saved his life. Dr. Dempsey and the rest of the critical care team then stabilized him and nursed him through the aftermath with incredible skill and care.

Throughout his entire stay, Dexter had a dedicated nurse with him at all times. Erin, Andrea, and countless others we crossed paths with (and many more whose names we never learned) treated him like he was their own. Every single person we dealt with was responsive, helpful, and endlessly understanding, even when we were falling apart with worry and calling at all hours.

I was referred to PASE by another emergency vet because PASE was one of the only hospitals in the area that had the right type of blood for my cat’s transfusion. From the ladies at the front desk, to the techs, to the doctors, everyone was friendly, welcoming, and did everything they could to make the situation easier. They followed up with me after my cat was discharged, and answered every question thoroughly and with patience. Everyone was wonderful.

We scheduled an appointment a month prior. They call me less than 24 hours before the appointment to let me know they have to cancel because they booked it with the wrong department.
I had my vet send them medical records the day after booking the appointment and even stated the issues my cat was having over the phone and in an email… and it still got booked with the wrong department. I even called them to make sure they received the vet records and everything was good for the appointment. They said yes.
We live 3 hours away and decided to rent a rental car and paid money for it. We picked it up a few hours before they called to cancel and now the car rental place will not reimburse us. We took time off of work for this appointment. So now I am out money for this rental car I don’t even need and wasted a PTO day.
I completely understand that mistakes happen but this is something that should have been caught earlier. I have now wasted time, money and PTO days over this.
My cat now has to wait even longer to be seen and we will NOT be going to this hospital. Thank goodness I found another vet clinic in NJ that is willing to help.
Dr. Davis and Laura in oncology are amazing. They took their time with us and answered all of our questions. We never felt rushed or dismissed. They are why we chose PASE for our pups treatments.
Wonderful veterinary hospital.  Don't hesitate to take your pet there.

I called them to ask how I could help my dying dog feel more comfortable as she was passing and they told me to bring her in for a $300 exam to see if she was actually dying. She did in fact pass the next day.

I absolutely can not overstate the incredible care my cat has received from PACE. All of the staff has been absolutely amazing from the care my cat has received, the reassurance they provide, the ability to contact them at anytime with questions and the constant and in depth updates. They staff here truly loves and takes such good care of all of the animals that they see. If your animal is in need of help I can’t recommend PACE enough

Brought my cat Zelda in for a severe decrease in appetite and discomfort while eating. On Thursday evening, I chose to have an extensive bloodwork panel done and was told that she has a lump in her stomach and would require an ultrasound the next day to investigate.

They do not have the proper equipment for dental screenings, I was told, so I assumed her mouth had been thoroughly checked to the best of their ability despite no imaging tools. It was reported to me she had halitosis.

I was quoted at $900 for the ultrasound and came back the next morning.

Dr. Wolstenholme was caring for my baby this time. I explained why I was there, asked if she could feel for a lump again in case it was just poop so that I might avoid unnecessary costs.

An hour later, she comes back with a picture of the back of Zelda’s throat where you can clearly see a tumor obstructing her throat and nasopharynx. While this was extremely hard to hear, I was grateful to Dr. Wolstenholme for listening to my concerns and doing a thorough check on her dental.

She laid out my options, never once scaring me into spending tons of money. She was honest, informed me that it would not be wrong to put her down now and that this kind of cancer is aggressive. She spent an hour on the phone with Penn to see if they’d be able to biopsy that afternoon.

With her compassionate explanations, I made the choice to give Zelda a beautiful day and have her put to sleep in the comfort of her home, surrounded by her loved ones.

With all of this being said, I give four stars, because I was dissatisfied with the service I received the previous night. However, I still would have gotten the bloodwork panel and had medicine administered to my Zelda, so I don’t feel that I was taken advantage of financially. The meds made her feel immensely better.

I just wish her teeth were checked thoroughly like Dr. Wolstenholme was able to. The first night, I gave her gabapentin, and the 2nd time I didn’t, so that means that Dr. Wolstenholme was committed to finding out what is wrong with my speedy skittish baby girl.

She even waived the exam fee yesterday and I only paid for the medication. A very compassionate touch that I will remember.

Edit: one more thing that brings it down to 3 stars, on Thursday, as I was silently crying paying almost $1k to go home with little answers, the receptionist behind the desk began to talk their coworker about going home relaxing and drinking, very loudly. I know it’s their job to be professional and unaffected, but in the moment it just felt like the wrong time to be saying that. Could have waited two minutes for me to pay and walk away.
Every person that I interacted with at PASE showed an abundance of compassion during the most devastating time.

We cannot say enough wonderful things about Dr. Krishnan and the entire team at PASE. Making the decision for Gary to have his eye removed was incredibly scary and emotional, but every single person made the process feel seamless, supported, and so much easier than we ever expected.
From the front desk team who greeted us with kindness, to the assistants and nurses who treated Gary like he was their own, to the doctors who helped guide us through every step — everyone was exceptional. Dr. Krishnan took the time to answer all of our questions, explain everything thoroughly, and made sure we felt informed and comfortable with the plan. Throughout the day, the team kept us updated and never left us wondering how Gary was doing, which meant more to us than they probably realize.
Most importantly, Gary is doing AMAZING. He recovered so well, adapted better than we ever imagined, and best of all — he is now cancer free. Looking back, although it was a scary decision, it was absolutely the right one for him.
We are beyond grateful to everyone at PASE for their compassion, communication, expertise, and the genuine care they showed our family. Thank you for taking such incredible care of our boy and helping give him many happy years ahead.

I recently had to bring my sister's dog to PASE after a scary incident where I thought he might have eaten a piece of plastic while I was watching him. I was really worried, but the second I walked in they got us in right away and moved incredibly fast.
Bre, Lucy, and Cyndi were absolutely amazing. They were so personable and kind, which honestly made a huge difference when I was stressed out. They knew what they were doing and explained everything clearly, which really helped calm my nerves.
Can't say enough good things about this place. If you need a vet that actually cares about your pet and treats you like a human being, go to PASE. Highly recommend!

After Riley was evaluated for a suspected urinary blockage, I was presented with treatment options at PASE. Because of the significant cost, I asked whether there were any lower-cost alternatives. I was advised to seek treatment at The Bridge.

Before leaving, I specifically expressed concern that The Bridge was a considerable distance away and that I did not have an appointment. Nurse Andrea assured me that The Bridge accepted walk-ins and encouraged me to go there because it would be less expensive.

Based on that information, I left PASE and drove Riley to The Bridge. Upon arrival, I was informed that they do not accept walk-ins and did not have a doctor available to see him. As a result, Riley could not receive treatment and I was forced to return to PASE, causing a delay in care during a medical emergency.

When I returned, I spoke with Shawna, who confirmed that the information provided by Nurse Andrea was incorrect. Shawna also informed me that The Bridge had previously contacted PASE to remind staff of its no-walk-in policy. Despite acknowledging that incorrect information had been provided, I was told no billing adjustment or accommodation would be considered because the issue did not constitute medical negligence.

To be clear, my complaint is not about the medical treatment Riley received. My concern is that I relied on inaccurate information provided by PASE staff when making an urgent treatment decision. Had I been given accurate information, I would have remained at PASE and proceeded with treatment there.
Very knowledgeable and extremely compassionate!
$1600 for bloodwork and X-rays for a cat

PASE has been so incredible through this tough journey. My dog came in paralyzed and we had been to multiple other hospitals fighting for answers and were only met with incompassionate workers who did not want to take the time to figure out what was going on. We were told just to put her down, that they didn’t have time, it wasn’t important, it wasn’t an emergency, etc. As a last resort, we were referred to PASE, and it was a breath of fresh air. The doctors took time to listen, answer questions, and make a plan tailored towards my dog’s health. I specifically want to recognize Dr Kerns, Steph in Neurology, Dr Zager, and the lovely receptionist Madz for being so kind and helpful through everything. They have shown so much compassion to my family and my pup and we couldn’t be more grateful for this wonderful team. Even though my dog may not ever recover from her injury, I have full confidence the PASE team did everything they could to give Tulip the best chance possible to walk again. On behalf of myself and Tulip, thank you all so much!
You can't get better staff. Friendly, courteous, helping you and your pet - tops.
Thank you for the 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and trust in our team. It means so much to us to know we were able to be there for you and your pet.
Thank you for the 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and trust in our team. It means so much to us to know we were able to be there for you and your pet.

Dr. Guttin and nurse Christy from internal medicine were absolutely FANTASTIC.  Dr. Guttin clearly spent a lot of time reviewing my dogs extensive history prior to my appointment and came with fantastic questions.  She was extremely thorough and listened to everything i had concerns about.  She also made sure to explain all my options and ultimately make the decision mine.  She was kind, compassionate, thorough, and very knowledgeable.  I had no hesitations leaving my dog there all day with the staff and would send any of my friends/ families pets there in a heart beat

Hershey sent us here for an mri because my esa pup was having back issues. These people said they won't do an mri unless I do surgery for 11k then proceeded to have us sit for 3 hrs until a specialist came in for $260 JUST TO SAY THE SAME THING!  I drove 2+ hrs spent over $600  for NOTHING!  Later we had to put my best friend down all within 24 hrs no blood taken nothing but a pain test because his back legs were paralyzed. Ik more tests could be done but this place only cares about making money.
We took our 7 y/o dog with coughing/sneezing symptoms. The staff was SO nice and professional.  Definitely recommend.

As a client, my first experience with PASE was in August/2025 when my dog Carlos needed an ultrasound and was referred there for that. The experience was truly great! The referral process though the website was easy, and the reception, ER, and radiology teams were great.

Fastforward to March/2026 said dog was brought back to PASE due to a ureterolith (stone in the ureter) and consequently an acute kidney injury (which is extra bad since he already has chronic kidney disease). From arrival at the clinic, checking in at the ER, talking to Dr. Simermeyer and later to the Internal Medicine and ECC teams everything was as good as it can be when you are worried your pet could die.
The CVTs were amazing at keeping us updated with pictures, and luckily, Carlitos passed his stone without the need for surgery (he would have had to be referred to Penn for that).
Costwise I would say PASE is around the same as Penn with the added benefit that things happen faster there due to it being a privately owned hospital and not an educational institution. There were no surprises with the bill; I was kept updated on the balance and the team got my consent when we had to increase the estimate to prolong Carlos' stay.

Carlos is now doing great for a dog with CKD. He has been having rechecks with the medicine team and I have nothing but compliments about the wonderful care he has received.

Shoutout to the reception, ER, ECC/ICU, medicine and radiology teams that were directly involved in my dog's care, and to everyone else I had the privilege to interact with while shadowing there, including the admins, Juan (his work is so important!), the neurology team, the surgery team, and the wonderful anesthetist. Truly top notch pet emergency service- kind, thorough, patient and pet-focused. The attention and care my pet received was excellent and I highly recommend!

Really disappointed. No wonder so many dogs at shelter. Vet care is ridiculously overpriced. Take you pet to nonprofit clinic instead.

This place really has a very professional and caring ,,responsible,,respectful way about themselves. The doctors and nurses took the time out to explain everything to me in layman's terms, and I love the relationship I built with my dog Max's  internal medical Doctor  Guttin..

BOTTOM LINE...DO NOT GO TO THIS FACILITY.  Took my dog in for diagnosis and treatment as to why he was not using his hind legs. The follow-up with Denise from Zurich, was unprofessional to say the least. Why would a facility not X-ray the limbs that were lame?  The signs all over the lobby say that my pet would be treated like family.  I wouldn't treat my worst enemy the way my dog was treated.  Not a single correspondence was received from PASE after I reached out, only from their ill-prepared insurance rep.  The vet was kind and informative but did not do what she relayed to me.  The front desk staff was wonderful.  The actual staff in the back, handing and "treating" animals should be ashamed and replaced with able-bodied, kind people.

Please also read the response from the owner, which again does not answer why my dog did not have access to his water, why he was treated so poorly, and why incomplete x-rays were done.  My dog was never diagnosed with neurological issues; I was told by the vet that they could not figure out what was wrong with him.  Again, had they x-rayed his hind legs as I was told they did (which was the reason we brought him in to begin with) they would have seen it was an issue with his hock joint.  Obviously, this facility got their money and is now attempting to wipe their hands of it.  By their own public admission, they refuse to even admit their failures.  Note to the owner, no one improves their business by denying and failing to acknowledge where they can improve.

Thank you for taking care of my dog and being so informative on his situation.

PASE is amazing!  I brough my 8 year old Doberman (Minna) in to find out why she seemd to be in alot of discomfort.  They diagnosed via an xray that she had a twisted stomach (GDV).  She would die within 24 hours if she didn't have emergency surgery.

Dr. Samuel was the best!  She explained all the issues to me and was extremely caring.  The outcome....success!!  4 days after surgery, Minna is doing great!

I am extremely thankful for the outcome.  However, the reason I am reviewing their service is not 100% outcome driven.  The staff at PASE is excellent and deserve recognition.  Everyone there was so kind and professional.  The front desk staff, the intake vet, the vet techs were all incredible.  Special kudos to Erin and Dr. Samuel.

I want to thank you all at PASE.  Minna and I are so thankful for your empathy and love!

It was a great visit! We were warmly greeted by staff after I stepped in to mention we were having parking issues and didn't want to be late for our appointment. They immediately guided me a parking area. Afterward, we were brought into a meeting room and met with a very knowledgeable vet tech/nurse (?) who took some information, answered all our questions then took our cat for an exam. Ultimately, we met with Dr. Lillie Davis, who was lovely in all respects. She explained, in depth and without giving us any sense of being up-sold, the disease process our cat was experiencing, his prognosis (with and without treatment) and the treatment options. She was very empathetic and professional. We highly recommend her and the staff at PASE. THEY ARE GREAT!

Dr. Swanson saw my dog immediately after he was referred by my primary veterinarian for suddenly being unable to walk. From the very first appointment she was compassionate, thorough, and honest. After examining him, she explained that there were three possible causes and recommended an MRI to find the exact problem.

The MRI confirmed exactly what she suspected. Unfortunately, my dog had a brain tumor and did not have much longer to live. While this was heartbreaking, having a clear diagnosis helped me make the difficult decision to put him down without wondering if I was doing the right thing. I couldn’t imagine watching him continue to decline and not knowing what was wrong.

I’m very grateful to Dr. Swanson for her kindness, honesty, and expertise during such a difficult time. She helped give me clarity and peace of mind when I needed it most.

I took my cat to PASE due to my kitty having very bad respiratory issues. Turns out he was going into heart failure and I had to put him down. They were respectful, kind, considerate, and up front about what was realistic in terms of treatment.

We brought him in. In seconds they took him back and had him assessed. They gave him a sedative and something to help with his heart. The care was definitely a 10/10. For emergency care their pricing is mid range. Not to expensive.  I’d recommend this place for sure.
Thanks for the 5 stars! It was awesome getting to know Duke!

They are very money motivated, they have no empathy, and damn near treated my dog dying n so nonchalantly as they realized I did not have $8,000 for a surgery.

Cannot thank PASE enough for their care and compassion. I found a very injured cat on my street last night and they took him in to try to help even though I did not know who the owner was (or if he had one). Gianna went above and beyond.

We had to rush our cat in for emergency care after calling our primary vet who recommended PASE. From the moment we arrived, the team was incredible. Within a minute of our arrival, he was taken back for vitals which immediately reassured us that he was in good hands.

Dr. Marshall checked in with us multiple times while they were running vitals and bloodwork, keeping us updated every step of the way. It truly felt like our cat was genuinely cared for, and the entire staff was knowledgeable and compassionate. The front desk team was also calm and friendly during a stressful time.

We’re incredibly grateful for the care we received and would highly recommend them for emergency services. Thank you Dr. Marshall and the entire PASE team!
Gianna is a great person! Helped me and Nippy. God bless.

I didn’t receive one of the prescriptions my pet needed out of the three I was given. I didn’t realize until 24 hrs later whenever I looked at my receipt. I came here for a neurology consult, scheduled with Dr. Swanson. While I felt hopeless for not being able to do the gold standard for my kitty due to finical constraints, she made me feel comfortable and at ease with the medicine route we took. Since her initial visit, I have kept touch with updates for Dr. Swanson and any questions I have, I receive a fairly quick response. I cant be any more happier for the care that was given. I highly recommend them! While it was a hike to get to and there wasn't much street parking, I do know that if I ever need speciality, I know exactly where to go. Thank you to the whole team at PASE for all you do and all the care you provide to the pets and their owners. 😊🩷

5 stars for the team at PASE! We brought our cat in and were blown away by the service. The front desk staff is top notch. They were super welcoming and professional. Marlene helped us so much, she is so knowledgeable and has the most calming energy. She explained everything we needed to know without making us feel overwhelmed. It’s clear they truly care about their patients and the owners. Highly recommend.
thanks!

Would highly recommend the Philadelphia Animal Specialty & Emergency Hospital.

PASE has cared for both of my Yorkies, Ace and Gizmo, with an exceptional level of skill, attention, and compassion that I will never forget.

I trust PASE deeply. Their professionalism, bedside manner, and dedication to their patients have earned my strongest recommendation. Thank you for taking such good care of my boys, twice.
Great !!!!!  Helped me and pet and didn't kill us with the Price !!!!!!!!!

First time at PASE on Washington Ave with my 15yo fur baby & I can't say enough about everyone. Ryan at Penn is great but it always seems so busy, chaotic & upsetting to bring her there so as an alternative PASE is terrific.  Most of the docs are Penn trained!
I just want to say thank you for everything 🙏 …

I really appreciate the team here for caring for Splendid Evening.

After some Hail Mary's from Dr Erica and her unbelievable team, we were able to bring Panda home after 6 days under their intensive care.   The amount of love and care shown throughout the entire experience was invaluable. Huge thank yous to Dr Erica and all of the nurses for caring for our puppy. We will be forever grateful.
If your pet is in need of urgent care, PASE is the place to go!

While convenient, and friendly staff, you end up getting expensive charges to either basically be told that you need to schedule time with a veterinarian or surgeon, or to be given basically no solution other than “wait and see”. Often better off just scheduling time with the regular vet.

Our 13 year old cat had become unable to eat or drink over the last week. Our primary vet through X-rays discovered that his entire GI track was empty and full of air but was otherwise uninformative. Sent us immediately to emergency center for ultrasound and IV. Ultrasound uninformative as well but emergency vet, based on his history (change in purr) scoped his throat and discovered left laryngeal paralysis, leading her to predict a neurological problem. She arranged for us to visit PASE, a 2-hr drive for us, for a neurology consult with Dr Kerns and an MRI. He confirmed diagnosis and also that left pupil smaller than right. Indication of a problem with nerves on left side of neck, probably due to a tumor. We elected not to do the MRI as only option to treat was surgically insert a feeding tube, but prognosis would remain poor. He gave our cat a shot of dexamethasone, which perked him up and allowed him to eat, giving him a couple extra days with us before euthanasia. I can’t say enough about PASE and the excellent and prompt and caring service the provided to us.

PASE has been an absolute lifesaver for my dog Sonny, who is a hemophiliac and requires extremely careful, consistent, and attentive medical care. Every single visit reinforces why I trust this hospital so deeply. The quality of care here is truly unmatched.

They take the time to explain everything, answer every question, and always make sure I feel informed and supported. Their expertise has given Sonny the chance to live comfortably and safely, and I am endlessly grateful for that.

The techs, front desk staff, and the entire critical care team deserve just as much praise. They treat Sonny with such gentleness and respect, remembering his needs, his limitations, and even his personality. It’s clear they care about him as more than just a patient—they care about him as if he were their own.

From start to finish, every interaction at PASE has been consistent, professional, compassionate, and reliable. Managing a hemophiliac dog can be stressful, but knowing Sonny is in the hands of a team this dedicated brings me immense peace of mind. I cannot recommend PASE highly enough.

I will never forget the date of August 24, 2025. That being said  my daughter and I had to rush our cat Gracie to the emergency clinic. When we walked in the door we were scared and unsure what expect. All of the staff noticed, Especially my Daughter . They treated us like family and made it feel like we were never alone that they would be there and helped comfort us throughout the entire process. Thank you guys for everything that you do, you helped my daughter and I get through One of the toughest things that we had to face.
The staff and the doctors are absolutely the best this is the second time they came to the rescue with are boy Kelly and my wife and I can’t thank you enough.

Took my dog in because of an eye infection. He's very nervous and always gets drugs before vet visits. Everyone was very accommodating, letting me handle him when possible and going slowly so he didn't spook. Dr. Martin was great, and so was our nurse Mariah!
Thank you!

They are absolutely the best at what they do. Don't hesitate to bring your pet here. We are lucky to have such amazing specialists in this city. I'm so glad to have found this animal hospital!

PASE provided attentive &  compassionate care for our injured dog, which included a spinal operation and nurse follow-up. the administrative team was organized and highly communicative. All the staff were great and we are grateful for their professionalism.
Friendly staff, clean office, knowledgeable doctors. Would recommend this pet er to every pet parent.

They took my cat back right away barely had to wait. They ran tests quick, knew what was wrong and treated him within that 1-2 hour period. Now they’re watching him overnight and the staff was super friendly and informative. I trust them with my baby!!

I didn’t have a good experience here. The staff came across as very money-focused and unwelcoming. Phone call answered immediately, clear instructions given by Madeline. My fur baby had to have an emergency surgery. Thank you PASE!!
We had a poisoning emergency, and they helped us out.  Friendly and competent staff!

Beyond grateful for the PASE team. Our Bernese mountain dog Hoagie got bloat and they had to operate on him right away. We are very grateful for the PASE team - this was a very traumatic experience for us and we are just so thankful it looks like Hoagie is on the other side of this because of the care of their team. Thank you PACE! Could not recommend enough.

This is by far the best place to take your animal. They truly care and treat your pets like their own. They helped me with my cat Wheezy when everyone else turned him away, and I’ll never forget the kindness and compassion they showed us. When it came time to have that heartbreaking end-of-life talk, I wouldn’t have wanted to be anywhere else. Everyone there genuinely loves their job, and it shows in everything they do. I’ll recommend them over and over again — they’re truly a blessing.

I can't express how much I love the Oncology department. They have been nothing but amazing! My sweet cat, Nimona, was recently diagnosed with Lymphoma which is definitely a scary time. They've been so informative and caring to me but more importantly, to Nimona. Dr. Davis and her techs really go above and beyond to make sure I understand everything and create a welcoming environment for my cat.

They do great work, really nice people, great doctors, techs and front desk personnel. All are so nice and kind to deal with. Made it easier to deal with some issue for our almost 14 year old Bichpoo. Have to say, they actually really do care which is always half the battle!!

We took our cat, Harry, to PASE after visits to our vet and a vet emergency care clinic both hit their limit for testing and imaging.  PASE personnel were gracious and thorough.  They pulled no punches and understood that costs and pain (both Harry's and ours) need to considered when looking to prolong a pet's life.  We were impressed.  Harry, we think of you all the time.

We went through the unfortunate experience of needing specialized emergency care for our dog which brought us to PASE through a recommendation from our primary vet. They fit us in for a procedure no other facility had an opening for within two months, but PASE made time to assess our boy and gave us thorough information. Dr. Lenker was attentive and professional, allowing us to ask as many questions as we needed. She evaluated everything and made recommendations based on her extensive expertise. She prepared us for a cancer diagnosis which we later received, and she stayed hours beyond her shift to perform surgery and give us her findings. Once diagnosed we were given an appointment with Dr. Davis for oncology. She was warm and kind, she let us share stories with her about Reggie.
